text: dsh-redo 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话重写插件，在对话每轮末尾提供“改后重发”入口。用户可编辑被取消、失败、中断或仍在运行的最后一轮提示词，并重新发送到原会话；可保留原提示词的图片和文件附件，也可添加新附件。插件会在界面内展示被替换尝试的提示词、结束原因和改动文件，并说明旧内容是否已从模型上下文中移除。适合需要修正一次未完成请求、又希望留在当前对话继续工作的用户；不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-redo adds an “Edit & resend” control to DSH web conversations. Revise and resend an unfinished final turn in the same session, reuse or add attachments, and view the replaced prompt, end reason, changed files, and context status. No extra API key is needed.
想把 DSH 里刚才中断或失败的最后一轮改好后接着发。
DSH 能不能让我编辑没完成的提示词，并留在原会话重试？
How can I revise and resend an unfinished prompt in the same DSH conversation?
dsh-redo 的功能「编辑并重发最后一轮」：在符合条件的对话轮末尾打开预填原提示词的编辑器，用户可修改文字、保留或添加附件后重新发送到当前会话。通过编辑器的重新发送按钮触发。
dsh-redo 的功能「查看上一版过程」：点击上一版按钮，可在对话内展开只读记录，查看被替换的提示词、结束原因、改动文件，以及该轮是否已从模型上下文中移除。
dsh-redo 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 11 天；提交数 4；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-redo README · dsh-redo：[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Rewrite the last turn of a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) session in place.

Send a prompt, watch it go the wrong way, press stop. This plugin adds a row to that turn so you can edit the prompt and send it again — without starting a new conversation, and without losing the files the first attempt already wrote.

dsh-redo README · What it does：- **Edit & resend** — opens an editor pre-filled with the interrupted prompt, attachments included. The edited prompt replaces the old one in the same conversation.
- **Previous** — a read-only record of the attempt that was replaced: its prompt, why it stopped, and which files it touched.

dsh-redo README · What it does：There is no second session and nothing is added to the sidebar. The arrow is not a navigator: opening the old branch for a glance would litter the sidebar with conversations, so the record is shown inline instead.

dsh-redo README · How the rewrite works：1. **The old turn is cancelled.** The same path the stop button uses (`sessionController.cancel`). Without it a still-running turn keeps thinking and writing while the edited prompt is already in flight. It is a no-op on an idle agent, so it runs unconditionally.
2. **The replaced range is shadowed on the model-visible surface.** A `user/message` with `surfaceOp: { op: 'replace', startSeq, endSeq }` covers the old prompt through the last node that turn produced — the same mechanism compaction uses. The model stops seeing that attempt and stops paying tokens for it. It is appended *before* the new prompt, so the new turn's own prompt stays its prompt.
3. **The replaced rows are hidden in the transcript.** Matched by `data-chat-turn` inside the current session's conversation element, so no other conversation is affected.

dsh-redo README · Where the hidden content goes：| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Does it still cost context? | No. It is shadowed out of the model-visible surface. |
| Is it deleted? | No. The log is append-only and Harness has no physical delete. |
| Where is it? | Still in `$DSH_HOME/sessions/.../session.v*.jsonl.zstd`, just no longer projected into model messages. |
| Why not delete it for real? | Fork, replay, export and audit all read that log. Compaction shadows ranges for the same reason. |
| Are my files affected? | No. Only what the model sees changes; the workspace is never touched. |
dsh-redo README · Where the hidden content goes：The panel states which case applies to each replacement, so you can tell a real context drop from a failed one.

dsh-redo README · Getting it：The repository is installable as a DSH bundle:

```sh
dsh plugin add <this repository>
```

Requires a Harness build that exposes `sessionController.cancel`, `sessionController.prompt` and `session.append`.

dsh-redo README · Behaviour：| Situation | Row shows |
| --- | --- |
| Stopped by you (`aborted`) | Edit & resend |
| Failed (`error`) | Edit & resend |
| Process interrupted (`interrupted`) | Edit & resend |
| Output limit (`max-tokens`) | Edit & resend |
| Still running | Edit & resend — it stops the turn first |
| Completed normally | Nothing |
| Not the last turn | Nothing |

Only the last turn can be rewritten. An earlier one would have to discard everything after it, which this plugin never does silently.

dsh-redo README · Development：- `test/host.cjs` — 48 checks. Mounts the Host half in a stub that reproduces Cordis's property trap, then exercises the full redo path against a synthetic session, including the open-turn, failed-prompt and concurrent-redo paths.
- `test/reload.cjs` — 9 checks. Replays the log through the real `adoptSessionEvent` and `foldSurface`, which is where a malformed stored message takes the whole session down. Skips itself when `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` is not installed.
- `test/render.cjs` — 52 checks. Renders the row through a minimal React runtime: conditional states, the editor, drag and drop, context hiding, contrast.
- `test/e2e.cjs` — scans the local session store and reports which turns the plugin would treat as redoable.
- `test/changes.cjs` — checks the changed-file extraction against a real log.
dsh-redo README · Development：`test/e2e.cjs` and `test/changes.cjs` read `$DSH_HOME/sessions` and skip when it is absent.

dsh-redo README · Notes for anyone changing this：**Do not read services as properties.** Cordis installs a trap on the context proxy: reading any property not declared in `inject` throws `cannot get property "X" without inject`, and because it is a getter, `?.` does not guard it. A stray `ctx.sessions` propagates to the chat row, so the error appears under every turn in every conversation. Use `ctx.get('name')`, which returns `undefined` instead.
dsh-redo README · Notes for anyone changing this：**Cancel before resending.** Sending a new prompt without stopping the old turn leaves both running; that was a real bug here.

dsh-redo README · Notes for anyone changing this：**An appended `user/message` needs an `id`.** The stored log is validated when it is *loaded*, not when an event is appended. One message without an identity makes the whole Session unopenable (`session event at seq N lacks an identified message`), and nothing looks wrong at the time. The shadow message gets one from `randomUUID()`, and `shadowProblem()` re-checks that rule together with the replacement-range rules before anything is written; when it fails the turn is simply left in context.
